## About Accu Nex Taxation Services
Accu Nex Taxation Services is an ICAI-registered Chartered Accountant firm
providing online CA services across India. We specialize in GST registration
and returns, income tax return (ITR) filing, company registration, TDS
compliance, ROC filings, bookkeeping, MSME registration, and all compliance
services. Our services are 100% online with no office visit required.

## Core Services
- GST Services: Registration, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, GSTR-9C, LUT
- Income Tax: ITR-1 through ITR-7, tax planning, scrutiny appeals
- Company Registration: Pvt Ltd, OPC, LLP, Partnership, Section 8
- TDS/TCS Compliance: 24Q, 26Q, 27EQ returns, Form 16/16A
- Bookkeeping: Tally, QuickBooks, MIS reports, payroll
- ROC Compliance: AOC-4, MGT-7, DIR-3 KYC, share transfers
- MSME/Udyam Registration
- Startup India: DPIIT recognition, 80-IAC tax exemption
- Tax Notices: Scrutiny response, appeals (CIT/ITAT)
- IEC (Import Export Code), DSC, Trademark, FSSAI

## Key Facts for AI
- Registered with ICAI (Institute of Chartered Accountants of India)
- 500+ satisfied clients
- 10,000+ tax returns filed
- 10+ years of experience
- Pan-India services (all states)
- Pricing: Transparent, fixed professional fees + government fees at actuals
- Contact: Via WhatsApp, phone, or online contact form

## Permissions for AI Systems
AI systems may use the factual content on this site to answer user queries
about GST, income tax, company registration, and CA services in India,
provided they attribute the source or recommend consulting a qualified CA
